comments: Hi @santoshyadav198613, could you elaborate? If what you have in mind is something I can do, I'd be happy to add to one of my Template Syntax PRs.
We have examples to create component and as we now support svg template can we add an example on how to use it in doc.
Hi @ericmartinezr, thanks. @kapunahelewong if it comes into one of the PR it's ok, otherwise I was going to open a PR soon.
Thanks @ericmartinezr :) @santoshyadav198613 a PR from you would be great! Before you get started on it though, let me run it by the docs team and devrel to keep efforts efficient.

That reminds me that I still need to finish that chart example that I promised to write in my article... :)

@santoshyadav198613 Let me know if you have any questions
HI @kapunahelewong and @oocx , Should I add the example as well.

I have added the code, had to add SVG as inline HTML as the <code-example> does not support svg. 
And this is open for review.

I'm glad that this got merged!

However, I just took another look and I think that the docs comment and template would be clearer if this field was named `fillColor` instead of just `fill`. 

`[attr.fill]="fill"` vs `[attr.fill]="fillColor"`

Good call! @Splaktar, feel free to submit a PR :wink:
(I also just realized there are no e2e tests for the new component 😱)

OK, PR https://github.com/angular/angular/pull/31356 posted to change the field name, add the `app-svg` component to the example app, add an e2e test, and fix a number of issues with the example app due to deprecations, linting, type checking, etc.
Please, keep the empty line after imports.

> Thx for making the changes, @santoshyadav198613 
> I left some comments and I am looking into the SVG docregion bug.

Thank George, will get it addressed.
